title: Momoi Airi — Full Power! Happy Everyday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, since it's so nice outside today, would you like to have lunch with me in the courtyard?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good.
Oh, hang on. Someone just sent me something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it's from Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She says that the principal of that elementary school sent her an email.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They also want to present us with a gift from the students but weren't sure where to send it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I knew we'd forgotten something... We don't have anything like that set up yet, do we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you mean a place where our fans can send us their letters and such...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, I appreciate how everyone's been sending us stuff digitally...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But this seems like a good opportunity for us to get started on that. Why don't we all discuss this after school?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
One week later

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, we're all here.
Let's open the package that the principal sent us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's not very big, but a lot heavier than it looks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it is. What could be inside?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, let's open it and find out.
Here goes nothing...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, isn't this the yearbook we made during the event...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it is! And there's one for each of us?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's great! We each get to keep one!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and I'll let the principal know that we received this later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, look.
It's the group photo we took with all the students.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. They look so happy too!
I can't help but smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, there's something else. Four envelopes to go with each yearbook it looks like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. They have our names on them too. This looks like mine... Here's Shizuku's...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here's yours, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wonder what's inside...
It feels sort of... Soft...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it does. Based on its size and how it feels, it could be something made of construction paper...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's open them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There... What the...?!
These look like... Pink flower petals?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, mine were light blue.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess they made flowers in each of our colors to act as cushions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. So that's why it felt so soft!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's such a nice way to cap things off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, there's a thank you card and some fan art by them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! They're in my envelope too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Thank you for visiting!> <Your show was really fun!> <We'll win at tag next time, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's great! They really crammed as much as they could onto these cards, huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Thank You Card
rows.Line: <Thank you, Happy Everyday! Thank you, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is it safe to say that our first solo gig was a success?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't help but go through all these messages.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
I can't wait to read the rest when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, quick suggestion. Mind if we move back the start of practice today by just a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, you want to read what the students wrote, right? Plus, we have a whole yearbook to go through.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think it'd be better if we take the time now to get it out of the way. Then we'll be able to have them in our hearts while we practice. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, then it's settled!
And let's get cracking!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A yearbook, fan art, flowers and a thank you card...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We really reached them. We gave them hope...)
